description: Vibe-coding guardrail scanners that run after every file edit. Report-only — they never block the edit, and degrade to no-op when a tool is absent. (1) security/secret scan, (2) format + lint, (3) type-check.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; if command -v semgrep >/dev/null 2>&1; then semgrep --config=auto "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v bandit >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then bandit "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks detect --source="$f" --no-git 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if grep -qE '(password|secret|key|token)\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]{8,}' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Warning: Potential hardcoded secrets detected in $f" >&2; fi

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.html|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --check "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1; then case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) eslint "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; fi;; *.py) if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; *.go) if command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then gofmt -l "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; *.rs) if command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustfmt --check "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) if command -v tsc >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; *.py) if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then mypy "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v pyright >/dev/null 2>&1; then pyright "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; esac
